findings.finding: The company is funded into 2029 (EUR110.9m cash at 2026-06-30) after an oversubscribed ~EUR86m follow-on in May 2026, and the full-text probe finds no going-concern language and no newer shelf takedown, so no offering or ATM draw is visible to price into the window ending 2026-10-05.
findings.mechanism_in_window: It bears on the window as the absence of the commonest second leg down (a financing after a fall); the May follow-on's lock-up language (6-K 2026-05-26) dates to that deal and has already run, and no 424B5 or FWP has been filed since 2026-05-22.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May 2026 raise came during the 05-12 to 05-21 cluster of falls (-9.9%, -6.5%, -6.6%, -6.6%, -6.9%), when continuation was common; outside a financing the name's comparable falls rose next day 58.5% of the time (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: A two-day fall of about 18% in a biotech usually prices some chance of a raise; with the runway into 2029 and the last deal four months old, that supply leg is unlikely here. If the price held this, the fall would look like a governance/momentum move with no dilution discount. It is a small, inferential positive.
